title: Terra Mage first playable scene with mock character
request: Create the first playable Terra Mage scene and a mock tiny mage character that can walk, run, and jump inside the scene. Programmer AI leads first. Use primitive mock art only; Creator/Blender assets stay secondary until Programmer requests specific assets. The scene must be set up and validated in Unity batchmode. Guardrail: Terra Mage gameplay scripts must use TerraMageInput, must not call UnityEngine.Input directly, and QA must fail if TerraMageTerraMageInput or other doubled rename identifiers appear.
